# EnterpriseGlue v0.16.2 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.16.1`.

## Highlights

- **plugin-installation-toolchain:** Completes reused Helm chart verification and binds release receipts to the exact immutable OCI registry archives delivered to customers.

## User and administrator impact

- Protected plugin-toolchain publication can complete when an existing immutable chart has canonically identical content but different archive metadata.
- Connected and offline release receipts now contain and hash the exact chart archives retrieved from the immutable registry subjects.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Both chart verification gates use the fail-closed canonical comparison for content equivalence.
- The release receipt separately records SHA-256 values for the exact immutable registry layer bytes that customers receive.

## Documentation

- The generated release notes distinguish canonical chart equivalence from exact registry-byte receipt integrity.

## Rollback

- Revert the workflow correction to return to the previous publication behavior; already published application images, toolchain images, and charts remain immutable.

## Validation evidence

- Canonical Helm archive tests covering metadata-only repacks, content and mode changes, links, added or unsafe paths, and malformed tar headers
- Protected plugin-toolchain policy checks covering both registry verification gates and registry-byte release receipts
- Published v0.16.2 plugin-toolchain workflow, signatures, distribution lock, deployment kit, and offline bundle

## Release metadata

- Release-note fragments: `plugin-toolchain-registry-receipt`
- Audiences: administrators, operators, developers, security
- Compatibility: backward-compatible
